scope: primary HIGH/MID/LOW all Fine; AUX policy remains separate
input: natural B128 words, two logical HV samples/beat, lane mask; no A-port access
polarization: H and V measured independently; common range selection does not imply common edge

power.noise: frozen onset noise snapshot per channel
power.raw_peak: max raw power for diagnostic/clip evidence
power.legacy_half_amplitude: max(power)/4 is not half-power and is not used

online_statistics.eop_hold_commit: bounded causal tail buffering/rollback so confirmation hold samples are excluded
online_statistics.too_large_hold: low-latency mode reject or explicit diagnostic fallback; no silent approximation

edge.threshold: per-pol P50 known before Fine read
edge.rising: first valid crossing in bounded coarse neighborhood
edge.falling: last valid crossing in bounded coarse neighborhood

body.definition: complete discrete samples strictly inside final edge window after guard
body.configuration: This build fixes guard=4 and segments=8 through the numerical contract; no runtime CSR changes these constants. Changing either requires a versioned numerical contract, reference and RTL update.

spectral.frequency: residual complex-baseband frequency after fixed RFDC NCO
spectral.main_path: adjacent complex products accumulated in time segments; no per-sample atan2

diagnostic_second_pass: not implicit; host uses RAW or explicit diagnostic mode

throughput.measurement_scope: See Fine F7 test: twelve full-depth three-range analytic pulses, concurrent RAW and replay. This is a workload measurement, not a guarantee for arbitrary multiple-crossing signals.
